String.name: codepoint-equal
String.description: Returns true if two strings are equal, considered codepoint-by-codepoint.

String.name: codepoints-to-string
String.description: Returns an xs:string whose characters have supplied codepoints.

String.name: collation-key
String.description: Given a string value and a collation, generates an internal value called a collation key, with the property that the matching and ordering of collation keys reflects the matching and ordering of strings under the specified collation.

String.name: compare
String.description: Returns -1, 0, or 1, depending on whether $comparand1 collates before, equal to, or after $comparand2 according to the rules of a selected collation.

String.name: concat
String.description: Returns the concatenation of the string values of the arguments.

String.name: contains-token
String.description: Determines whether or not any of the supplied strings, when tokenized at whitespace boundaries, contains the supplied token, under the rules of the supplied collation.

String.name: encode-for-uri
String.description: Encodes reserved characters in a string that is intended to be used in the path segment of a URI.

String.name: escape-html-uri
String.description: Escapes a URI in the same way that HTML user agents handle attribute values expected to contain URIs.

String.name: iri-to-uri
String.description: Converts a string containing an IRI into a URI according to the rules of .

String.name: lower-case
String.description: Converts a string to lower case.

String.name: normalize-space
String.description: Returns the value of $arg with leading and trailing whitespace removed, and sequences of internal whitespace reduced to a single space character.

String.name: normalize-unicode
String.description: Returns the value of $arg after applying Unicode normalization.

String.name: resolve-uri
String.description: Resolves a relative IRI reference against an absolute IRI.

String.name: string-join
String.description: Returns a string created by concatenating the items in a sequence, with a defined separator between adjacent items.

String.name: string-length
String.description: Returns the number of characters in a string.

String.name: string-to-codepoints
String.description: Returns the sequence of codepoints that constitute an xs:string value.

String.name: substring
String.description: Returns the portion of the value of $sourceString beginning at the position indicated by the value of $start and continuing for the number of characters indicated by the value of $length.

String.name: translate
String.description: Returns the value of $arg modified by replacing or removing individual characters.

String.name: upper-case
String.description: Converts a string to upper case.

SubstringMatching.name: contains
SubstringMatching.description: Returns true if the string $arg1 contains $arg2 as a substring, taking collations into account.

SubstringMatching.name: ends-with
SubstringMatching.description: Returns true if the string $arg1 contains $arg2 as a trailing substring, taking collations into account.

SubstringMatching.name: starts-with
SubstringMatching.description: Returns true if the string $arg1 contains $arg2 as a leading substring, taking collations into account.

SubstringMatching.name: substring-after
SubstringMatching.description: Returns the part of $arg1 that follows the first occurrence of $arg2, taking collations into account.

SubstringMatching.name: substring-before
SubstringMatching.description: Returns the part of $arg1 that precedes the first occurrence of $arg2, taking collations into account.

PatternMatching.name: analyze-string
PatternMatching.description: Analyzes a string using a regular expression, returning an XML structure that identifies which parts of the input string matched or failed to match the regular expression, and in the case of matched substrings, which substrings matched each capturing group in the regular expression.

PatternMatching.name: matches
PatternMatching.description: Returns true if the supplied string matches a given regular expression.

PatternMatching.name: replace
PatternMatching.description: Returns a string produced from the input string by replacing any substrings that match a given regular expression with a supplied replacement string.

PatternMatching.name: tokenize
PatternMatching.description: Returns a sequence of strings constructed by splitting the input wherever a separator is found; the separator is any substring that matches a given regular expression.

Numeric.name: ceiling
Numeric.description: Rounds $arg upwards to a whole number.

Numeric.name: floor
Numeric.description: Rounds $arg downwards to a whole number.

Numeric.name: format-integer
Numeric.description: Formats an integer according to a given picture string, using the conventions of a given natural language if specified.

Numeric.name: format-number
Numeric.description: Returns a string containing a number formatted according to a given picture string, taking account of decimal formats specified in the static context.

Numeric.name: number
Numeric.description: Returns the value indicated by $arg or, if $arg is not specified, the context item after atomization, converted to an xs:double.

Numeric.name: random-number-generator
Numeric.description: Returns a random number generator, which can be used to generate sequences of random numbers.

Numeric.name: round
Numeric.description: Rounds a value to a specified number of decimal places, rounding upwards if two such values are equally near.

Numeric.name: round-half-to-even
Numeric.description: Rounds a value to a specified number of decimal places, rounding to make the last digit even if two such values are equally near.

DateAndTime.name: adjust-date-to-timezone
DateAndTime.description: Adjusts an xs:date value to a specific timezone, or to no timezone at all; the result is the date in the target timezone that contains the starting instant of the supplied date.

DateAndTime.name: adjust-dateTime-to-timezone
DateAndTime.description: Adjusts an xs:dateTime value to a specific timezone, or to no timezone at all.

DateAndTime.name: adjust-time-to-timezone
DateAndTime.description: Adjusts an xs:time value to a specific timezone, or to no timezone at all.

DateAndTime.name: dateTime
DateAndTime.description: Returns an xs:dateTime value created by combining an xs:date and an xs:time.

DateAndTime.name: day-from-date
DateAndTime.description: Returns the day component of an xs:date.

DateAndTime.name: day-from-dateTime
DateAndTime.description: Returns the day component of an xs:dateTime.

DateAndTime.name: days-from-duration
DateAndTime.description: Returns the number of days in a duration.

DateAndTime.name: format-date
DateAndTime.description: Returns a string containing an xs:date value formatted for display.

DateAndTime.name: format-dateTime
DateAndTime.description: Returns a string containing an xs:dateTime value formatted for display.

DateAndTime.name: format-time
DateAndTime.description: Returns a string containing an xs:time value formatted for display.

DateAndTime.name: hours-from-dateTime
DateAndTime.description: Returns the hours component of an xs:dateTime.

DateAndTime.name: hours-from-duration
DateAndTime.description: Returns the number of hours in a duration.

DateAndTime.name: hours-from-time
DateAndTime.description: Returns the hours component of an xs:time.

DateAndTime.name: minutes-from-dateTime
DateAndTime.description: Returns the minute component of an xs:dateTime.

DateAndTime.name: minutes-from-duration
DateAndTime.description: Returns the number of minutes in a duration.

DateAndTime.name: minutes-from-time
DateAndTime.description: Returns the minutes component of an xs:time.

DateAndTime.name: month-from-date
DateAndTime.description: Returns the month component of an xs:date.

DateAndTime.name: month-from-dateTime
DateAndTime.description: Returns the month component of an xs:dateTime.

DateAndTime.name: months-from-duration
DateAndTime.description: Returns the number of months in a duration.

DateAndTime.name: parse-ietf-date
DateAndTime.description: Parses a string containing the date and time in IETF format, returning the corresponding xs:dateTime value.

DateAndTime.name: seconds-from-dateTime
DateAndTime.description: Returns the seconds component of an xs:dateTime.

DateAndTime.name: seconds-from-duration
DateAndTime.description: Returns the number of seconds in a duration.

DateAndTime.name: seconds-from-time
DateAndTime.description: Returns the seconds component of an xs:time.

DateAndTime.name: timezone-from-date
DateAndTime.description: Returns the timezone component of an xs:date.

DateAndTime.name: timezone-from-dateTime
DateAndTime.description: Returns the timezone component of an xs:dateTime.

DateAndTime.name: timezone-from-time
DateAndTime.description: Returns the timezone component of an xs:time.

DateAndTime.name: year-from-date
DateAndTime.description: Returns the year component of an xs:date.

DateAndTime.name: year-from-dateTime
DateAndTime.description: Returns the year component of an xs:dateTime.

DateAndTime.name: years-from-duration
DateAndTime.description: Returns the number of years in a duration.

Boolean.name: boolean
Boolean.description: Computes the effective boolean value of the sequence $arg.

Boolean.name: not
Boolean.description: Returns true if the effective boolean value of $arg is false, or false if it is true.

QName.name: in-scope-prefixes
QName.description: Returns the prefixes of the in-scope namespaces for an element node.

QName.name: local-name-from-QName
QName.description: Returns the local part of the supplied QName.

QName.name: namespace-uri-for-prefix
QName.description: Returns the namespace URI of one of the in-scope namespaces for $element, identified by its namespace prefix.

QName.name: namespace-uri-from-QName
QName.description: Returns the namespace URI part of the supplied QName.

QName.name: prefix-from-QName
QName.description: Returns the prefix component of the supplied QName.

QName.name: QName
QName.description: Returns an xs:QName value formed using a supplied namespace URI and lexical QName.

QName.name: resolve-QName
QName.description: Returns an xs:QName value (that is, an expanded-QName) by taking an xs:string that has the lexical form of an xs:QName (a string in the form "prefix:local-name" or "local-name") and resolving it using the in-scope namespaces for a given element.

Node.name: base-uri
Node.description: Returns the base URI of a node.

Node.name: data
Node.description: Returns the result of atomizing a sequence. This process flattens arrays, and replaces nodes by their typed values.

Node.name: document-uri
Node.description: Returns the URI of a resource where a document can be found, if available.

Node.name: has-children
Node.description: Returns true if the supplied node has one or more child nodes (of any kind).

Node.name: innermost
Node.description: Returns every node within the input sequence that is not an ancestor of another member of the input sequence; the nodes are returned in document order with duplicates eliminated.

Node.name: lang
Node.description: This function tests whether the language of $node, or the context item if the second argument is omitted, as specified by xml:lang attributes is the same as, or is a sublanguage of, the language specified by $testlang.

Node.name: local-name
Node.description: Returns the local part of the name of $arg as an xs:string that is either the zero-length string, or has the lexical form of an xs:NCName.

Node.name: name
Node.description: Returns the name of a node, as an xs:string that is either the zero-length string, or has the lexical form of an xs:QName.

Node.name: namespace-uri
Node.description: Returns the namespace URI part of the name of $arg, as an xs:anyURI value.

Node.name: nilled
Node.description: Returns true for an element that is nilled.

Node.name: node-name
Node.description: Returns the name of a node, as an xs:QName.

Node.name: outermost
Node.description: Returns every node within the input sequence that has no ancestor that is itself a member of the input sequence; the nodes are returned in document order with duplicates eliminated.

Node.name: path
Node.description: Returns a path expression that can be used to select the supplied node relative to the root of its containing document.

Node.name: root
Node.description: Returns the root of the tree to which $arg belongs. This will usually, but not necessarily, be a document node.

Node.name: string
Node.description: Returns the value of $arg represented as an xs:string.

Sequence.name: available-environment-variables
Sequence.description: Returns a list of environment variable names that are suitable for passing to fn:environment-variable, as a (possibly empty) sequence of strings.

Sequence.name: avg
Sequence.description: Returns the average of the values in the input sequence $arg, that is, the sum of the values divided by the number of values.

Sequence.name: collection
Sequence.description: Returns a sequence of items identified by a collection URI; or a default collection if no URI is supplied.

Sequence.name: count
Sequence.description: Returns the number of items in a sequence.

Sequence.name: deep-equal
Sequence.description: This function assesses whether two sequences are deep-equal to each other. To be deep-equal, they must contain items that are pairwise deep-equal; and for two items to be deep-equal, they must either be atomic values that compare equal, or nodes of the same kind, with the same name, whose children are deep-equal, or maps with matching entries, or arrays with matching members.

Sequence.name: distinct-values
Sequence.description: Returns the values that appear in a sequence, with duplicates eliminated.

Sequence.name: doc
Sequence.description: Retrieves a document using a URI supplied as an xs:string, and returns the corresponding document node.

Sequence.name: doc-available
Sequence.description: The function returns true if and only if the function call fn:doc($uri) would return a document node.

Sequence.name: element-with-id
Sequence.description: Returns the sequence of element nodes that have an ID value matching the value of one or more of the IDREF values supplied in $arg.

Sequence.name: empty
Sequence.description: Returns true if the argument is the empty sequence.

Sequence.name: environment-variable
Sequence.description: Returns the value of a system environment variable, if it exists.

Sequence.name: exactly-one
Sequence.description: Returns $arg if it contains exactly one item. Otherwise, raises an error.

Sequence.name: exists
Sequence.description: Returns true if the argument is a non-empty sequence.

Sequence.name: generate-id
Sequence.description: This function returns a string that uniquely identifies a given node.

Sequence.name: head
Sequence.description: Returns the first item in a sequence.

Sequence.name: id
Sequence.description: Returns the sequence of element nodes that have an ID value matching the value of one or more of the IDREF values supplied in $arg.

Sequence.name: idref
Sequence.description: Returns the sequence of element or attribute nodes with an IDREF value matching the value of one or more of the ID values supplied in $arg.

Sequence.name: index-of
Sequence.description: Returns a sequence of positive integers giving the positions within the sequence $seq of items that are equal to $search.

Sequence.name: insert-before
Sequence.description: Returns a sequence constructed by inserting an item or a sequence of items at a given position within an existing sequence.

Sequence.name: json-doc
Sequence.description: Reads an external resource containing JSON, and returns the result of parsing the resource as JSON.

Sequence.name: json-to-xml
Sequence.description: Parses a string supplied in the form of a JSON text, returning the results in the form of an XML document node.

Sequence.name: max
Sequence.description: Returns a value that is equal to the highest value appearing in the input sequence.

Sequence.name: min
Sequence.description: Returns a value that is equal to the lowest value appearing in the input sequence.

Sequence.name: one-or-more
Sequence.description: Returns $arg if it contains one or more items. Otherwise, raises an error.

Sequence.name: parse-json
Sequence.description: Parses a string supplied in the form of a JSON text, returning the results typically in the form of a map or array.

Sequence.name: parse-xml
Sequence.description: This function takes as input an XML document represented as a string, and returns the document node at the root of an XDM tree representing the parsed document.

Sequence.name: parse-xml-fragment
Sequence.description: This function takes as input an XML external entity represented as a string, and returns the document node at the root of an XDM tree representing the parsed document fragment.

Sequence.name: remove
Sequence.description: Returns a new sequence containing all the items of $target except the item at position $position.

Sequence.name: reverse
Sequence.description: Reverses the order of items in a sequence.

Sequence.name: serialize
Sequence.description: This function serializes the supplied input sequence $arg as described in , returning the serialized representation of the sequence as a string.

Sequence.name: subsequence
Sequence.description: Returns the contiguous sequence of items in the value of $sourceSeq beginning at the position indicated by the value of $startingLoc and continuing for the number of items indicated by the value of $length.

Sequence.name: sum
Sequence.description: Returns a value obtained by adding together the values in $arg.

Sequence.name: tail
Sequence.description: Returns all but the first item in a sequence.

Sequence.name: unordered
Sequence.description: Returns the items of $sourceSeq in an implementation-dependent order.

Sequence.name: unparsed-text
Sequence.description: The fn:unparsed-text function reads an external resource (for example, a file) and returns a string representation of the resource.

Sequence.name: unparsed-text-available
Sequence.description: Because errors in evaluating the fn:unparsed-text function are non-recoverable, these two functions are provided to allow an application to determine whether a call with particular arguments would succeed.

Sequence.name: unparsed-text-lines
Sequence.description: The fn:unparsed-text-lines function reads an external resource (for example, a file) and returns its contents as a sequence of strings, one for each line of text in the string representation of the resource.

Sequence.name: uri-collection
Sequence.description: Returns a sequence of xs:anyURI values representing the URIs in a URI collection.

Sequence.name: xml-to-json
Sequence.description: Converts an XML tree, whose format corresponds to the XML representation of JSON defined in this specification, into a string conforming to the JSON grammar.

Sequence.name: zero-or-one
Sequence.description: Returns $arg if it contains zero or one items. Otherwise, raises an error.

Context.name: current-dateTime
Context.description: Returns the current date and time (with timezone).

Context.name: default-collation
Context.description: Returns the value of the default collation property from the static context.

Context.name: default-language
Context.description: Returns the value of the default language property from the dynamic context.

Context.name: error
Context.description: Calling the fn:error function raises an application-defined error.

Context.name: implicit-timezone
Context.description: Returns the value of the implicit timezone property from the dynamic context.

Context.name: last
Context.description: Returns the context size from the dynamic context.

Context.name: position
Context.description: Returns the context position from the dynamic context.

Context.name: static-base-uri
Context.description: This function returns the value of the static base URI property from the static context.

Context.name: trace
Context.description: Provides an execution trace intended to be used in debugging queries.

Math.name: math:acos
Math.description: Returns the arc cosine of the argument.

Math.name: math:asin
Math.description: Returns the arc sine of the argument.

Math.name: math:atan
Math.description: Returns the arc tangent of the argument.

Math.name: math:atan2
Math.description: Returns the angle in radians subtended at the origin by the point on a plane with coordinates (x, y) and the positive x-axis.

Math.name: math:cos
Math.description: Returns the cosine of the argument. The argument is an angle in radians.

Math.name: math:log
Math.description: Returns the natural logarithm of the argument.

Math.name: math:log10
Math.description: Returns the base-ten logarithm of the argument.

Math.name: math:pi
Math.description: Returns an approximation to the mathematical constant π.

Math.name: math:pow
Math.description: Returns the result of raising the first argument to the power of the second.

Math.name: math:sin
Math.description: Returns the sine of the argument. The argument is an angle in radians.

Math.name: math:sqrt
Math.description: Returns the non-negative square root of the argument.

Math.name: math:tan
Math.description: Returns the tangent of the argument. The argument is an angle in radians.

MapFunctions.name: map:contains
MapFunctions.description: Tests whether a supplied map contains an entry for a given key

MapFunctions.name: map:entry
MapFunctions.description: Returns a map that contains a single entry (a key-value pair).

MapFunctions.name: map:find
MapFunctions.description: Searches the supplied input sequence and any contained maps and arrays for a map entry with the supplied key, and returns the corresponding values.

MapFunctions.name: map:for-each
MapFunctions.description: Applies a supplied function to every entry in a map, returning the concatenation of the results.

MapFunctions.name: map:get
MapFunctions.description: Returns the value associated with a supplied key in a given map.

MapFunctions.name: map:keys
MapFunctions.description: Returns a sequence containing all the keys present in a map

MapFunctions.name: map:merge
MapFunctions.description: Returns a map that combines the entries from a number of existing maps.

MapFunctions.name: map:put
MapFunctions.description: Returns a map containing all the contents of the supplied map, but with an additional entry, which replaces any existing entry for the same key.

MapFunctions.name: map:remove
MapFunctions.description: Returns a map containing all the entries from a supplied map, except those having a specified key.

MapFunctions.name: map:size
MapFunctions.description: Returns the number of entries in the supplied map.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:append
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns an array containing all the members of a supplied array, plus one additional member at the end.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:filter
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns an array containing those members of the $array for which $function returns true.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:flatten
ArrayFunctions.description: Replaces any array appearing in a supplied sequence with the members of the array, recursively.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:fold-left
ArrayFunctions.description: Evaluates the supplied function cumulatively on successive members of the supplied array.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:fold-right
ArrayFunctions.description: Evaluates the supplied function cumulatively on successive values of the supplied array.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:for-each
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns an array whose size is the same as array:size($array), in which each member is computed by applying $function to the corresponding member of $array.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:for-each-pair
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns an array obtained by evaluating the supplied function once for each pair of members at the same position in the two supplied arrays.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:get
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns the value at the specified position in the supplied array (counting from 1).

ArrayFunctions.name: array:head
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns the first member of an array, that is $array(1).

ArrayFunctions.name: array:insert-before
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns an array containing all the members of the supplied array, with one additional member at a specified position.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:join
ArrayFunctions.description: Concatenates the contents of several arrays into a single array.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:put
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns an array containing all the members of a supplied array, except for one member which is replaced with a new value.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:remove
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns an array containing all the members of the supplied array, except for the members at specified positions.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:reverse
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns an array containing all the members of a supplied array, but in reverse order.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:size
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns the number of members in the supplied array.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:sort
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns an array containing all the members of the supplied array, sorted according to the value of a sort key supplied as a function.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:subarray
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns an array containing all members from a supplied array starting at a supplied position, up to a specified length.

ArrayFunctions.name: array:tail
ArrayFunctions.description: Returns an array containing all members except the first from a supplied array.

HigherOrder.name: apply
HigherOrder.description: Makes a dynamic call on a function with an argument list supplied in the form of an array.

HigherOrder.name: filter
HigherOrder.description: Returns those items from the sequence $seq for which the supplied function $f returns true.

HigherOrder.name: fold-left
HigherOrder.description: Processes the supplied sequence from left to right, applying the supplied function repeatedly to each item in turn, together with an accumulated result value.

HigherOrder.name: fold-right
HigherOrder.description: Processes the supplied sequence from right to left, applying the supplied function repeatedly to each item in turn, together with an accumulated result value.

HigherOrder.name: for-each
HigherOrder.description: Applies the function item $action to every item from the sequence $seq in turn, returning the concatenation of the resulting sequences in order.

HigherOrder.name: for-each-pair
HigherOrder.description: Applies the function item $action to successive pairs of items taken one from $seq1 and one from $seq2, returning the concatenation of the resulting sequences in order.

HigherOrder.name: function-arity
HigherOrder.description: Returns the arity of the function identified by a function item.

HigherOrder.name: function-lookup
HigherOrder.description: Returns the function having a given name and arity, if there is one.

HigherOrder.name: function-name
HigherOrder.description: Returns the name of the function identified by a function item.

HigherOrder.name: load-xquery-module
HigherOrder.description: Provides access to the public functions and global variables of a dynamically-loaded XQuery library module.

HigherOrder.name: sort
HigherOrder.description: Sorts a supplied sequence, based on the value of a sort key supplied as a function.

HigherOrder.name: transform
HigherOrder.description: Invokes a transformation using a dynamically-loaded XSLT stylesheet.

XSLT.name: accumulator-after
XSLT.description: Returns the value of the named accumulator after processing the context node and its descendants.

XSLT.name: accumulator-before
XSLT.description: Returns the value of the named accumulator before processing the context node.

XSLT.name: available-system-properties
XSLT.description: Returns the names of all system properties available from the XSLT processor.

XSLT.name: copy-of
XSLT.description: Creates deep copies of nodes and returns atomic values unchanged, useful in streaming to capture a grounded copy.

XSLT.name: current
XSLT.description: Returns the item that was the context item at the point where the expression was invoked from the XSLT stylesheet.

XSLT.name: current-group
XSLT.description: Returns the contents of the current group selected by xsl:for-each-group.

XSLT.name: current-grouping-key
XSLT.description: Returns the grouping key of the current group within xsl:for-each-group.

XSLT.name: current-merge-group
XSLT.description: Returns the items within the current merge group that share the same merge key value, within xsl:merge.

XSLT.name: current-merge-key
XSLT.description: Returns the merge key value shared by all items in the current merge group, within xsl:merge.

XSLT.name: current-output-uri
XSLT.description: Returns the URI of the current output destination being written to by xsl:result-document.

XSLT.name: document
XSLT.description: Provides access to XML documents identified by a URI.

XSLT.name: element-available
XSLT.description: Tests whether an XSLT instruction with the given name is available in the processor.

XSLT.name: function-available
XSLT.description: Tests whether a function with the given name and optionally arity is available for use in XPath expressions.

XSLT.name: key
XSLT.description: Returns the nodes that match a given key value, as defined by an xsl:key declaration.

XSLT.name: regex-group
XSLT.description: Returns the substring captured by a parenthesized sub-expression of the regular expression used by xsl:analyze-string.

XSLT.name: snapshot
XSLT.description: Creates a copy of nodes that preserves ancestor and namespace context, useful for streamed processing.

XSLT.name: stream-available
XSLT.description: Tests whether a resource identified by the given URI is available for streaming via xsl:source-document.

XSLT.name: system-property
XSLT.description: Returns the value of a system property identified by a QName (e.g., xsl:version, xsl:vendor).

XSLT.name: type-available
XSLT.description: Tests whether a schema type with the given name is available for use in the stylesheet.

XSLT.name: unparsed-entity-public-id
XSLT.description: Returns the public identifier of an unparsed entity declared in the DTD of the document containing the context node.

XSLT.name: unparsed-entity-uri
XSLT.description: Returns the URI of an unparsed entity declared in the DTD of the document containing the context node.
